metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.8 · 1969 · Tora-san, Our Lovable Tramp
metas.description: Tora-San, an itinerant peddler who is thrown out of his father's house twenty years before but reconnects with his aunt, uncle and sister Sakura. Tora wreaks some havoc in their lives, like getting drunk and silly at a marriage me...

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.0 · 1969 · Tora-San's Cherished Mother
metas.description: Kuruma Torajiro is discovered looking around Kyoto for someone special to him.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.6 · 1970 · Tora-san, His Tender Love
metas.description: Traveling salesman Kuruma Torajirō falls in love with an inn manager as New Year's approaches.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.6 · 1970 · Tora-san's Grand Scheme
metas.description: After winning big at the races, Torajiro Kuruma wants to take his aunt and uncle on a trip to Hawaii to partly pay the great filial debt he feels he owes them, but the plan hits a snag.  Also, a pretty kindergarten teacher rents a room at Toraya.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 6.7 · 1970 · Tora-san's Runaway
metas.description: After an encounter with a dying yakuza's son and at his sister Sakura's urging, Torajiro attempts to change his vagrant lifestyle and become an honest worker with a steady job.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 6.7 · 1971 · Tora-san's Shattered Romance
metas.description: Torajiro becomes homesick during his travels after watching a television report about his hometown and meeting a young woman that reminds him of his sister Sakura.  Meanwhile, a new tenant moves into Toraya restaurant.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 6.9 · 1971 · Tora-san, the Good Samaritan
metas.description: After a quarrel with his mother, Torajiro sets off to find a bride.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 6.6 · 1972 · Tora-san's Dear Old Home
metas.description: While Sakura and Hiroshi struggle to save funds to build a house, Torajiro befriends three young women on vacation during his travels.

metas.name: 9 · ★ 6.7 · 1972 · Tora-san's Dream-Come-True
metas.description: When Tora-san returns to visit his family, he is surprised to find an arrogant professor occupying his room. The professor and Tora-san become rivals for the affection of Chiyo.

metas.name: 10 · ★ 6.8 · 1973 · Tora-san's Forget Me Not
metas.description: On the road again, Torajiro meets a kindred spirit in Lily, a lounge singer.

metas.name: 11 · ★ 6.5 · 1973 · Tora-San Goes French
metas.description: Tora-San returns to Shibamata just before his family leaves on a trip for Kyushu.  Later, he encounters an old school chum and begins to have feeling for his artist sister.

metas.name: 12 · ★ 6.7 · 1974 · Tora-san's Lovesick
metas.description: After Torajiro's latest attempt to find a bride goes awry, he starts traveling again and runs into Utako (last seen in Tora-san's Dear Old Home), now a widow.

metas.name: 13 · ★ 6.4 · 1974 · Tora-san's Lullaby
metas.description: After Hiroshi is injured in a workplace accident, Torajiro gives Sakura the money he has saved and leaves to work as a traveling salesman once again.  During his travels, Torajiro meets a father who shares a drink with him.  In the morning, Torajiro is shocked to learn that the man has left his baby behind and a note asking Tora to take care of the child.

metas.name: 14 · ★ 7.1 · 1975 · Tora-san's Rise and Fall
metas.description: Tora-san visits Hokkaido and is reunited with Lily. Now divorced, she plans to resume her singing career and renews her unusual relationship with Tora-san.

metas.name: 15 · ★ 6.8 · 1975 · Tora-san, the Intellectual
metas.description: Tora-san is inspired to pursue an education after a visit to the grave of a woman he met years ago.  When he returns to Shibamata with the intent to study, he falls for Toraya's new tenant instead.

metas.name: 16 · ★ 7.1 · 1976 · Tora-san's Sunrise and Sunset
metas.description: Tora-san arrives in Shibamata on Mitsuo's first day of school only to find that on his account, Mitsuo was embarrassed. After a fight with his family, he goes to a bar to drink, then brings home a surly old man with a sad story, w...

metas.name: 17 · ★ 6.7 · 1976 · Tora-san's Heart of Gold
metas.description: When Tora-san's infatuation with his nephew's school teacher causes family turmoil, he leaves on his travels again. When he returns, he falls in love with the teacher's mother, who has a terminal illness.

metas.name: 18 · ★ 6.8 · 1977 · Tora-san Meets His Lordship
metas.description: Tora-san befriends the descendant of a feudal lord.  The man asks Tora to locate his deceased son's wife who resides somewhere in Tokyo.

metas.name: 19 · ★ 6.6 · 1977 · Otoko wa tsurai yo: Torajiro gambare!
metas.description: Tora-san becomes friends with Toraya's newest tenant, a pachinko-playing electrician that goes by the nickname Watt.  Tora attempts to match Watt with a young waitress.

metas.name: 20 · ★ 6.1 · 1978 · Stage-struck Tora-san
metas.description: Tora-san leaves Shibamata once again after an argument with his family and finds himself at an inn where he meets Tomekichi, a young man who looks up to Tora-san.

metas.name: 21 · ★ 6.5 · 1978 · Talk of the Town Tora-san
metas.description: After a chance encounter with Hiroshi's father on a bus, Tora decides to get serious and reflect on the mortality of man.  His plans are derailed when a beautiful lady starts working at Toraya.

metas.name: 22 · ★ 6.5 · 1979 · Tora-san, the Matchmaker
metas.description: Tora-san helps out a runaway bride.

metas.name: 23 · ★ 6.8 · 1979 · Tora-san's Dream of Spring
metas.description: Tora-san's opinions about Americans get challenged when another wandering peddler Michael Jordan stops by Shibamata.

metas.name: 24 · ★ 7.0 · 1980 · Tora-san's Tropical Fever
metas.description: When cabaret singer Lily writes Toraya about her illness, Tora-san rushes to Okinawa to be by her side.

metas.name: 25 · ★ 6.6 · 1980 · Otoko wa tsurai yo: Torajiro kamome uta
metas.description: After a friend and business colleague dies, Tora-san visits the man's daughter, then takes her to Tokyo so she can study for a night school exam.

metas.name: 26 · ★ 6.9 · 1981 · Tora-san's Love in Osaka
metas.description: When his travels bring him to Osaka, Tora-san falls in love with a local geisha. He helps her to track down her estranged brother, and informs his family that he plans to marry her. His plans are foiled when the geisha informs Tora-san that she is engaged.

metas.name: 27 · ★ 6.4 · 1981 · Tora-san's Promise
metas.description: Tora-san returns to his family's home to attend an elementary school class reunion. After he embarrasses himself by getting drunk and insulting all his ex-classmates, he resumes his travels. In Kyushu he meets an outspoken 18-year-old girl who becomes enamored of Tora-san and follows him around. One of Tora-san's old friends is terminally ill and makes Tora-san promise him to marry his wife once he is gone.

metas.name: 28 · ★ 6.7 · 1982 · Hearts and Flowers for Tora-san
metas.description: During his travels, Tora-san gets drunk with an old man in Kyoto. Though Tora-san never fully comprehends his importance, the old man is a Living National Treasure ceramist. At his home, Tora-san makes a good impression on the old man's maid, who apparently falls in love with Tora-san.

metas.name: 29 · ★ 6.6 · 1982 · Tora-san, the Expert
metas.description: Tora-san gets into an argument with his uncle and sets out on the road again. In Kyushu he meets a young woman named Keiko and the shy zoologist Saburō, and attempts to play matchmaker between the two when they all return to Tokyo.

metas.name: 30 · ★ 6.9 · 1983 · Tora-san Goes Religious?
metas.description: Tora-san visits brother-in-law Hiroshi's hometown to attend a memorial service for his late father. When the local temple priest becomes intoxicated, Tora-san wearing the priest's robe delivers the memorial speech, much to his family's surprise. Thinking he's found his true calling, Tora-san decides to join the order, and falls for the priest's divorced daughter.

metas.name: 31 · ★ 6.4 · 1984 · Tora-san's Forbidden Love
metas.description: Tora-san spends several days at the home of a hard-working salaryman ("salaried worker"), who abruptly disappears. When the man's wife asks Tora-san to help find him, he falls in love with her, and secretly hopes the husband will not be found.

metas.name: 32 · ★ 7.0 · 1987 · Tora-san Goes North
metas.description: When his travels take him to rural Hokkaido, Tora-san helps a cantankerous old veterinarian (Mifune) in his relationships with his estranged daughter, and a woman in whom he is secretly interested.

metas.name: 33 · ★ 6.7 · 1987 · Tora-san Plays Daddy
metas.description: A playboy-gambler friend of Tora-san’s dies and, abandoned by his mother, his little boy suddenly turns up in Shibamata. Searching for the boy’s mother, Tora-san meets a cosmetics saleslady and the three become a surrogate family, with Tora-san as “daddy”.

metas.name: 34 · ★ 6.3 · 1989 · Otoko wa tsurai yo: Torajiro kokoro no tabiji
metas.description: During his wandering throughout Japan, Tora-san meets a suicidal man. He travels with the man to Vienna, but winds up homesick for Japan.

metas.name: 35 · ★ 6.9 · 1989 · Otoko wa tsurai yo: Boku no ojisan
metas.description: Tora-san's nephew Mitsuo is exchanging letters with Izumi, a former classmate whose parents divorced and took her out of Tokyo.

metas.name: 36 · ★ 6.8 · 1990 · Tora-san Takes a Vacation
metas.description: Mitsuo goes to Nagoya to visit Izumi, whose father left Izumi’s sad, bar hostess mother for another woman, so together they decide to confront him in Oita. Meanwhile, Izumi’s mother befriends Tora-san and together they travel to Oita to meet them, with Tora-san quickly falling for her en route.

metas.name: 37 · ★ 7.1 · 1995 · Tora-san to the Rescue
metas.description: Tora-san works hard to bring together his nephew, Mitsuo, and Mitsuo’s girlfriend who is engaged to someone else.

metas.name: 38 · ★ 7.1 · 1971 · Tora-san's Love Call
metas.description: Taking a message from Hiroshi's father to heart, Torajiro attempts to give up his wandering ways.
